title: Information Research Department (IRD)
titleEs: Departamento de Investigación de la Información (IRD)
excerpt: Semi-secret Foreign Office unit that from 1948 to 1977 fed unattributable anti-communist material to journalists, writers and governments, and ran black propaganda abroad.
excerptEs: Unidad semisecreta del Foreign Office que de 1948 a 1977 suministró material anticomunista sin atribución a periodistas, escritores y gobiernos, y practicó propaganda negra en el extranjero.

sources.title: FO 1110: Information Research Department, General Correspondence, series description (The National Archives, Kew)
Giselle Gwinnett, The demise of the Information Research Department in 1977 (PhD thesis, University of Warwick, 2021)
Orwell offered writers' blacklist to anti-Soviet propaganda unit (The Guardian, 11 July 1996; reproduced by the University of Pennsylvania)
Christopher Hitchens, Orwell's List (The New York Review of Books, 2002)
Kenjataan2 ('Facts'): IRD black newsletter for Indonesia, documents from The National Archives (Nicholas Gilby)
Paul Lashmar and James Oliver, Britain's Secret Propaganda War 1948-1977 (Sutton, 1998)
